Sun Nov 15: Upper Body + Core

~50 min · Easy on your back and calf · Seated & supported

0%On phoneOffline ✓
Safety first: Mild muscle soreness is normal. If you get back pain beyond normal soreness, like sharp, pinching, or radiating pain, or that familiar upper/mid-back pain coming back, stop that exercise and check with your PT before doing it again. No hip hinges or RDLs for now.
Today: back sore, calf acting up. Everything is seated, supported or on the floor. No leg work, no calf raises, no jumping, no lunges or squats. Skip any move that bothers your back or calf, or switch to the other tab or an alternative. If your calf is swollen, warm or red, or it hurts to walk on, skip the gym and get it checked first.
Go light. Your chest and shoulders were very sore after last time, so leave 3–4 reps in the tank every set. Use the Machine | Dumbbells tabs to pick whatever’s free. The page remembers your pick and logs which one you did.
How to use this page
  • Swipe each exercise’s photos to see the movement; the last slide is the video. Tap it to play, or use the red button to open YouTube. Tap Set buttons as you finish each set. Your progress is saved on this phone.
  • Weight rule: pick a weight where you finish each set feeling like you could do 3–4 more good reps today. If you could do 7+ more, go up a little next set.
  • Write down the weight/pin number for each machine so we can progress next time.
  • Afterward, tell me how it felt, what was too easy/hard, and anything sore.

Warmup

~5 min · upper body only. Skip the bike today if your calf is bothering you

1

Arm circles

1 x 20 sec each way
Target weight: Bodyweight
Rest: —

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight. Small circles, getting a little bigger.

Alternatives: Shoulder rolls, or easy arm swings across your body

  • Stand or sit tall, arms straight out to the sides
  • 20 sec forward, then 20 sec backward
  • Shoulders relaxed, away from your ears

2

Band pull-aparts

2 sets × 15 reps
Target weight: Light band
Rest: 20 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Lightest band on the rack. If the Y has no bands, do 15 slow reps of the light cable face pull instead.

Alternatives: Light cable face pull, or reverse fly machine at a very light weight

  • Arms straight out at chest height, hands shoulder-width on the band
  • Pull the band apart to your chest by squeezing your shoulder blades
  • Ribs down, don't arch your low back or shrug

PT block

~5 min · loosen the back and wake up the upper back

3

Cat cow (PT)

1 x 10
Target weight: Bodyweight
Rest: —

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight. Move within a comfortable range.

Alternatives: Seated cat cow on a bench if kneeling bothers your calf

  • Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, toes relaxed
  • Breathe in as you drop the belly and lift the chest; breathe out as you round the back
  • Move slow, one segment of the spine at a time

Search YouTube for more demos →

4

Prone Y raise (PT)

2 sets × 8 reps
Target weight: Bodyweight
Rest: 30 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight. Small lift, slow, with a 2 sec hold at the top. Skip it if lying face down bothers your back.

Alternatives: Band pull-aparts overhead, or skip if it pinches

  • Lie face down, arms overhead in a Y, thumbs pointing up
  • Lift your arms a few inches by drawing shoulder blades down and back
  • Keep your neck long (look at the floor) and don't arch your low back

Upper body

~30 min · seated or supported. Pick Machine or Dumbbells on each card

5

Chest press

Seated chest press machine

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: ~40–50 lb
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Go light: you were very sore after last time. Stop each set with 3–4 reps left in the tank.

Alternatives: Incline chest press machine, or seated cable chest press

  • Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest
  • Back and head on the pad, shoulders down
  • Press out without locking your elbows, return slowly

Search YouTube for more demos →

Low-incline dumbbell press

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: ~15–20 lb each
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bench on the first or second notch (low incline). Stop each set with 3–4 reps left. Sit the dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back with them.

Alternatives: Flat dumbbell bench press, or palms-facing-in grip if your shoulders feel cranky

  • Back, head and butt stay on the bench; feet flat
  • Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, elbows about 45° from your body
  • Press up over your chest; finish by bringing them back to your thighs as you sit up

Search YouTube for more demos →

6

Row

Chest-supported row machine (or seated row machine)

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: ~50–60 lb
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Moderate. Pause 1 sec with your shoulder blades squeezed every rep. The chest pad keeps your back out of it.

Alternatives: Seated cable row, or single-arm cable row

  • Chest against the pad, sit tall, feet planted
  • Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, elbows back
  • Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let the arms go long slowly

Search YouTube for more demos →

Chest-supported incline dumbbell row

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: ~15–20 lb each
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bench at a 30–45° incline. Moderate weight, pause at the top of each rep.

Alternatives: Single-arm dumbbell row with a hand and knee on a flat bench

  • Lie chest-down on the incline bench, feet on the floor or the bench frame
  • Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs, elbows back
  • Chest stays on the pad. Lower slowly

Search YouTube for more demos →

7

Lat pulldown

3 sets × 10 reps
Target weight: ~50–60 lb
Rest: 90 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: You skipped this last time. Start light: pull to your upper chest without leaning back much. Stop with 3–4 reps left.

Alternatives: Assisted pull-up machine (more assist = easier), or close-grip/V-bar pulldown

  • Thigh pad snug, grip a little wider than shoulders
  • Chest up, pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back
  • Control it on the way up, don't let the weight yank you

Alt video: Assisted pull-up machine demo: How To Use The Assisted Pull Up Machine (PureGym)

Biceps curl

Biceps curl machine (preacher style)

3 sets × 12 reps
Target weight: ~30–40 lb
Rest: 60 sec

Swipe for photos → video

Weight: Moderate. Smooth reps, 2–3 sec on the way down.

Alternatives: Cable curl with a straight bar, or cable preacher curl

  • Seat height so your armpits are snug on the top of the pad
  • Curl up without lifting your elbows off the pad
  • Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight

Seated dumbbell curl

3 sets × 12 reps
Target weight: ~12–15 lb each
Rest: 60 sec

Swipe for photos → video

Weight: Sit on a bench with the back support up. Moderate, no swinging.

Alternatives: Seated hammer curl (palms facing in), or incline dumbbell curl

  • Sit tall with your back against the pad, arms at your sides
  • Curl up with palms facing up, elbows stay by your sides
  • Lower slowly. Alternate arms if that's easier

Triceps

Cable triceps pushdown (rope)

3 sets × 12 reps
Target weight: ~30–40 lb
Rest: 60 sec

Weight: You did this last time. Light-moderate; only your forearms move.

Alternatives: Straight bar or V-bar pushdown, or the seated triceps extension machine

  • Push the rope down and spread it apart at the bottom
  • Return slowly to chest height, don't let elbows drift forward

Rest: 60 sec

  • Bend only at the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head

Rest: 60 sec

Core

~10 min · back-friendly: no crunches or sit-ups

11

Resisted dead bug

2 sets × 8/side
Target weight: Bodyweight
Rest: 30 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Same band as your home program (or no band). Slow and controlled beats heavy.

Alternatives: Plain dead bug with no band, or heel taps lying on your back

  • Low back gently pressed into the floor the whole time
  • Breathe out as you reach the opposite arm and leg away
  • If your back arches, shorten the reach

Search YouTube for more demos →

12

Cable Pallof press

2 sets × 10/side
Target weight: ~10–15 lb
Rest: 30 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Cable at chest height, light. Stand with weight even on both feet; half-kneel if your calf doesn't like standing.

Alternatives: Band Pallof press, or half-kneeling Pallof press

  • Stand side-on to the cable, feet hip-width, knees soft
  • Press hands straight out from your chest and hold 2 sec
  • Resist the pull, don't let your torso rotate

Alt video: Band version: How to do a Standing Banded Pallof Press (TurnFit)

Search YouTube for more demos →

13

Side plank from knees

2 sets × 20–30 sec/side
Target weight: Bodyweight
Rest: 30 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight, knees bent. Stop before your form breaks.

Alternatives: Side plank clamshell (your PT version), or a front plank on forearms and knees

  • Elbow under your shoulder, knees bent and stacked
  • Lift your hips so knees, hips and shoulders make a straight line
  • Keep breathing, don't let your hips sag or roll back

Search YouTube for more demos →

14

Bird dog

2 sets × 8/side
Target weight: Bodyweight
Rest: 30 sec

Swipe for photos → video

▶ Open video in YouTube

Weight: Bodyweight. Hold each reach 2 sec. Slow is the point.

Alternatives: Bird dog with just the arm or just the leg if balance is shaky

  • Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, toes relaxed
  • Reach the opposite arm and leg long without lifting the hips
  • Keep your back flat, like balancing a cup of water on it
